content.text:
The data can't settle the direction by itself, so I used domain knowledge. A C6 radiculopathy is a nerve-root lesion, and it produces symptoms in the arm. A symptom in the arm doesn't cause a root lesion.

The counts point the same way. When L C6 radiculopathy is present, arm problems appear in 119 of 4,320 cases. When arm problems are present, C6 radiculopathy is also present in 119 of 142 cases. Arm problems are rare overall and almost always occur alongside the radiculopathy. That fits the arm problems being a consequence of it.

ANSWER: B
